rationale: Twenty independent AI contributions with two separate, source-grounded simulations of named competition judges and author revision; later blinded assessment of sealed candidates.
effective_from: first round explicitly binding this version
comparability: Different method and observed settings from prior batches; no controlled superiority claim. Judge fidelity and selection validity remain empirical questions.
independent_critique: A first named-judge review is the canonical critique stage; a second independently captured named-judge review supplements it before author revision. Both are separate fresh sessions with only this essay and the assigned judge evidence. No cross-essay memory. Authors may disagree with either review.
budget: Twenty authorized essays, two named-judge reviews each, one defended author revision; full panel assessment of the sealed shortlist. No word minimum. Contest ceiling remains. Claude runs use manual subscription access when available; no paid APIs.
